title: Scholar's Interiors
description: This is a Datapack for the Dalekmod, which adds all the Scholars' Interiors of the Tardises.
body: This is a Datapack for the Dalekmod, which adds all the Scholars' Interiors of the Tardises. There are some subtle connections to two of the Tardises, the Built, and the First/Second Scholar's Tardis. I hope you enjoy my blue boxes!
